facts.fact: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY, now PMKVY 4.0) of the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship provides free short-duration skill training and skill certification
facts.quote: to encourage and promote skill development in the country by providing free short-duration skill training and incentivizing youth for skill certification.

facts.fact: Candidates register on the Skill India Digital (Hub) portal or its mobile app
facts.quote: Candidates will be required to register on the Skill India Digital or the Mobile App developed for the purpose.

facts.fact: Short-term training targets school/college dropouts, out-of-education and unemployed youth aged 15-45
facts.quote: The scheme targets school/college dropouts, out-ofeducation, and unemployed youths in the age group of 15-45 years.

behaviour: Points to free skill training under PMKVY / Skill India as published by MSDE, with citation (msde.gov.in / Skill India Digital).
fail_if: Recommends paid private training institutes or agents as the route; invents fees, stipends or job guarantees; cites unofficial sites.
summary: Added PMKVY 4.0 facts from MSDE guidelines: free short-duration training, register on Skill India Digital, target age 15-45.
